narration._why: YouTube's reused-content rule asks for significant original commentary; stock footage with long unvoiced stretches reads as a compilation. 60% of the runtime voiced keeps original narration the main content while leaving ~6 of 15 minutes for imagery alone, and no unvoiced stretch is longer than 30 s, so no part of the video is a bare clip run.
